{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''family''' of [[Srrors'tok]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] lived on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Sellasas]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. During a Rebel [[Siege of Sellasas|siege]] on Sellasas, Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] all of the members of the Srrors'tok family except [[Tyionsis Cex]].<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>
